18474	### The honest bottom line
18475	
18476	The source document's own verdict is _"for a competitive real-time game, choose none of them as the complete
18477	solution"_ — and this plan agrees rather than contradicting it. What plan-v2 delivers is the durable
18478	low-frequency signed-command plane the analysis recommends **plus** the two planes it says must exist
18479	alongside it (ephemeral, sharding), with an operator relay spine. It does **not** deliver an authoritative
18480	simulation or anti-cheat; §10.2's authority plane is a role the library exposes and the application fills.
18481	
18482	So: a **chat-ready** app is fully in scope for Train C + Phase 7 (this is the profile the plan can take
18483	furthest on pure P2P). An **MMORPG-ready** app is in scope in the sense the source document endorses — zone-
18484	instanced, ephemeral transforms off the DAG, durable commands only, operator relays for fanout and
18485	compaction liveness. A seamless single-shard world with serverless competitive anti-cheat is a non-goal
18486	(§0.6), and no amount of compaction work changes that.
